fields.description: EEPROM validity sentinel. Rev8-logical bytes are 78 56 34 12 = u32 0x12345678.
fields.evidence: FUN_08018068 reads 8-byte EEPROM block addr 0 (4x u16 via DMA FUN_08017fe8 from 0x0D000000) into RAM; FUN_08018120 is the matching 8-byte write path; FUN_08018204 verifies the same 4-short block. Rev8-logical offset 0 decodes to 0x12345678 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Bitmask of unlocked tracks (bit i = track i open). Baseline 0x09 opens tracks 0 and 3.
fields.evidence: Byte 4 of the 8-byte EEPROM block moved by FUN_08018068 (read) / FUN_08018120 (write) / FUN_08018204 (4-short compare); game-level dispatcher is behind the indirect jumptable at 0x08018118, so role is inferred from position and baseline value 0x09.
fields.name: unlocked_tracks

fields.evidence: Byte 5 of the 8-byte EEPROM block moved by FUN_08018068 (read) / FUN_08018120 (write) / FUN_08018204 (4-short compare); game-level dispatcher is behind the indirect jumptable at 0x08018118, so role is inferred from position and baseline value 0x08.
